summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of the Portuguese landing page for 'Viciado em Tela, Refém da Insônia' digital guide. All critical features are working correctly including countdown timer with localStorage persistence, all sections rendering properly, FAQ accordion functionality, sticky bar scroll behavior, and mobile responsiveness.

design_issues.issue: When clicking hero CTA button to scroll to offer section, the offer section ends up 335px from viewport top instead of being closer (50-100px would be better UX)
design_issues.recommendation: Consider adding scroll-margin-top or adjusting scroll behavior to position offer section closer to viewport top for better user experience

passed_tests: Page loads without errors (no red screen, no breaking console errors)
Hero section: badge 'Você não está sozinho', H1 'Viciado em tela', countdown timer (data-testid=hero-countdown) showing MM:SS format
Hero section: CTA button (data-testid=hero-buy-button) links to #oferta, social proof '+2.000 pessoas', hero image loads correctly
Countdown timer ticks down every second (verified 29:58 → 29:55 over 3 seconds)
Countdown persistence: timer value persists across page reload (localStorage key 'nr_offer_deadline' working correctly, timer did NOT reset to 30:00)
All countdown instances synchronized: hero, pricing, final, and sticky countdowns all show same time
Pain section: 4 pain cards (data-testid=pain-point-card) present, pain image loads correctly
Stats section: 3 stats (data-testid=stats-band-stat) with correct values: 90%, 2h+, 1 em 3
Science section: 3 cards (data-testid=science-explainer-card) with correct titles: A Luz Azul, A Dopamina, O Ciclo Circadiano
Modules section: 4 module cards (data-testid=module-card) Módulo 1-4 present
Protocol section: 5 numbered steps (data-testid=protocol-step) present
Before/After section: both images load correctly (data-testid=before-after-before-image and before-after-after-image, naturalWidth > 0)
Testimonials: 6 cards (data-testid=testimonial-card) with 5 stars each
Author section (data-testid=author-quote-block) with 'Siebra Neto' signature present
Offer section id=oferta: offer card, price display (R$ 39,99 crossed → R$ 19,99), countdown, CTA button, Kiwify seal all present
Guarantee block (data-testid=guarantee-block) with 'Garantia incondicional de 7 dias' present
FAQ: 5 items (data-testid=faq-item), first one open by default, toggle functionality works (clicking opens/closes answers)
Final CTA section: countdown (data-testid=final-countdown) and CTA button (data-testid=final-buy-button) present
Sticky bottom bar (data-testid=sticky-purchase-bar): hidden at top of page (translate-y-full class), becomes visible after scrolling past 550px (translate-y-0 class)
Sticky bar contains: price R$ 19,99, live countdown (data-testid=sticky-countdown), 'Comprar agora' button (data-testid=sticky-buy-button) linking to #oferta
All images load successfully: hero image, pain image, before/after images, testimonial avatars (all naturalWidth > 0)
Mobile viewport (390x844): layout stacks correctly, no horizontal overflow, sticky bar visible after scroll
Console logs clean: only one non-critical Cloudflare RUM request failure (monitoring endpoint, doesn't affect functionality)

success_percentage.backend: N/A (frontend-only landing page, backend not tested as instructed)
